description: Commission of Elections - Notify the name of a member that vacated his office of member at Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections, specifically fitting Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which includes "Electoral commission appointments and decisions" and matters related to candidate status and vacancies.
